title: A Survey on Multilingual Large Language Models: Corpora, Alignment, and Bias
findings: The paper surveys existing findings, noting that models exhibit religious biases. For example, models show stereotypical associations (e.g., associating the Torah specifically with Judaism). It also cites research finding that GPT-3 stereotypically associates Muslims with violence more than other religious groups. Furthermore, it notes that multilingual models like mBERT and XLM-R show varying degrees of bias related to religion across different languages.
